defp to_dollars(cents) do
  if rem(cents, 100) == 0, do: div(cents, 100), else: cents / 100
end

def add_expense(state, amount, category) do
  if not (is_number(amount) and amount > 0), do: raise("amount must be a positive number")
  if not (is_binary(category) and String.trim(category) != ""), do: raise("category must be a non-empty string")
  cents = to_cents(amount)
  if cents < 1, do: raise("amount must be at least 0.01")
  category = String.trim(category)
  expenses = Map.get(state, "expenses", [])
  id = length(expenses) + 1
  expense = %{"amount" => to_dollars(cents), "category" => category}
  {id, Map.put(state, "expenses", expenses ++ [expense])}
end
